comparison.objective: Recover finishing media from washers with a separating screen vs clear a printer jam and resume printing.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled granular sifting and washer retention vs synchronized bimanual straight pulling without tearing a card, followed by button pressing.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires full feed, ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, no loss/damage, and released 3 s support dwell; record requires intact card removal, table placement, OK press/print resumption, and 1 s clearance.
comparison.reason: Both use two arms, but they test unrelated flow-separation and balanced-extraction abilities.
